prompt:
You are a medical ontology assistant tasked with organizing the 10 variables below.

For each variable, propose:
- a normalized concept,
- a semantic category (Symptom, Disease, Treatment, Biomarker, Assessment, Demographic, Lifestyle, etc.),
- one relevant relation, when appropriate.

Use only the information provided.
Return one simple result per variable.

Answer strictly as a JSON array, one object per variable, with the keys:
"variable", "normalized_concept", "semantic_category", "relation".

Variables:
- PR | type: binary numeric | example: 0 / 1 | description: presence of rheumatoid arthritis (0 = absence, 1 = presence)
- BRI | type: continuous numeric | example: 4.82 | description: Body Roundness Index, unitless
- Age | type: integer | example: 22 | description: age in years
- SmokingStatus | type: categorical text | example: Former | description: Never / Current / Former
- BMI | type: continuous numeric | example: 27.4 | description: body mass index in kg/m2
- DrinkingStatus | type: ordinal categorical text | example: Occasional drinker | description: Almost non-drinker / Occasional drinker / Frequent drinker
- Hypertension | type: binary categorical text | example: Normal | description: Normal / Hypertension
- Diabetes | type: categorical text | example: Prediabetes | description: Normal / Prediabetes / Diabetes
- Hyperlipidemia | type: binary categorical text | example: Normal | description: Normal / Hyperlipidemia
- PhysicalActivity | type: ordinal categorical text | example: Moderate activity | description: Sedentary / Moderate activity / Vigorous activity / Other
